verdict.line: You lose if you facetank his Grit-empowered auto plus W (Haymaker) point-blank before level 6; you win by poking with W (Siphon of Destruction) from outside his range and closing with R (Realm of Death) once he's chunked.

brief.thesis: Sett has zero ranged threat and zero dash — his entire kit requires him to walk into melee, while your Q (Obliterate) and W (Siphon of Destruction) both threaten from beyond his auto-attack range. That range gap plus his complete lack of an escape (no blink, no dash) means R (Realm of Death) is close to a free kill once you land it, since he cannot leave the isolated zone.

theirWindow.when: Grit bar full and W (Haymaker) off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Do not trade face-to-face here. Back off and force him to walk the distance — the empowered auto plus a landed Haymaker in one exchange swings a trade hard, and the Haymaker heal scales up sharply once he's below roughly 30% HP.

yourWindow.what: Walk him down behind minions with Q/W chip, then flash-confirm range and drop R (Realm of Death). He has no dash or blink to leave the isolated zone, so once you commit the duel he cannot disengage.

start.why: The flat damage reduction on the next attack and regen negate his early passive-empowered auto chip when he walks up to farm.

boots.why: Every source of his damage — passive punch, W (Haymaker), R (The Show Stopper) — is physical, so flat armor outvalues MR here.

core.why: HP and armor to shrug off his all-in, plus the burn adds free damage while you're kiting with W poke
Magic pen and omnivamp let you win extended trades and duels once you commit R
MR and heal amp round out your tankiness for the mid-game 1v1 pattern this lane rewards

situational.when: he is snowballing and sustaining fights off his passive punch heal and W (Haymaker) heal — grievous wounds guts both
he builds crit/attack speed and is landing empowered autos too consistently
their team stacks magic damage around him and armor alone is no longer enough

runes.keystoneWhy: This is a stack-and-stick matchup once R is down — Conqueror's ramping adaptive damage and healing win the extended duels R forces.

summoners.why: Flash guarantees you land R (Realm of Death) at the right moment or dodge a Facebreaker/Haymaker; Teleport lets you shove and reset since neither champion has a real pre-6 roam.

playing.title: Poke with W on cooldown
playing.detail: Siphon of Destruction outranges his entire kit — throw it whenever he pushes to farm instead of waiting for a big trade window.

playing.title: Never facetank a full Grit bar
playing.detail: If his Grit bar is capped and W (Haymaker) is up, disengage rather than trading — the empowered auto and Haymaker combo in one exchange is his only real damage spike.

playing.title: Time E for his alpha strike
playing.detail: Pop Indestructible right before his Facebreaker or empowered auto lands so the shield eats the burst instead of chip damage from his punches.

playing.title: Don't stand in Facebreaker range for free
playing.detail: E (Facebreaker) needs enemies on both sides to knock up hard — stay on one side of him near minions so he can only get the weak single-side hit.

playing.title: Commit R only after chunking him
playing.detail: Land two W pokes first, then walk up and drop Realm of Death — he has no dash to leave the zone, so the duel is guaranteed once you're in.

playing.title: Respect his ult grab range
playing.detail: R (The Show Stopper) is a short dash-grab, not a skillshot from far away — keep minion/terrain between you when you're below half HP even though you outrange him otherwise.

playing.title: Prioritize anti-heal if he's ahead
playing.detail: If he's sustaining through your poke off his passive and W heal, hold or rush Thornmail — grievous wounds cuts both healing sources hard.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Mordekaiser bruiser build and Conqueror precision setup I know — verify these still exist and check current numbers (Haymaker's low-HP heal scaling, Realm of Death's escape-block rules) against the live patch before champ select, since specific values and item availability may have shifted.
